description: Add GitHub Actions CI workflow for linting (ruff) and running tests (pytest) on push and pull request events.
steps: Create .github/workflows/ci.yml with a workflow that: triggers on push and pull_request to main, uses ubuntu-latest, sets up Python 3.11, installs dev dependencies (pip install ruff pytest), runs 'ruff check src/ tests/', runs 'pytest tests/ -v'
Ensure the workflow name and job names are descriptive (e.g., 'Tarkistukset' for the workflow name in Kouvola dialect)
acceptance_criteria: File .github/workflows/ci.yml exists and is valid YAML
Workflow triggers on push and pull_request
Workflow runs ruff check and pytest
verification: python -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/ci.yml'))" 2>/dev/null || python3 -c "import pathlib; content=pathlib.Path('.github/workflows/ci.yml').read_text(); assert 'ruff' in content and 'pytest' in content and '3.11' in content; print('CI workflow valid')"
findings: CI workflow created at .github/workflows/ci.yml. Verification passed. No network access needed since the file is just YAML that runs on GitHub.
